issues.description: Let a shopper share a wishlist via a signed URL.
issues.acceptance: Given a wishlist, when share is clicked, then a signed URL is copied.

issues.description: Homepage row of the last eight viewed SKUs.
issues.acceptance: Given eight viewed SKUs, when home loads, then those SKUs appear in order.

issues.description: Merge anonymous cart into the signed-in cart.
issues.acceptance: Given an anonymous cart and an account cart, when the shopper signs in, then line items merge.

issues.description: Do not offer unavailable color swatches on PDP.
issues.acceptance: Given a color with zero stock, when PDP loads, then that swatch is disabled.

issues.description: Validate and apply a single promo code.
issues.acceptance: Given a valid code, when applied, then the discount line is visible.

issues.description: Accept digital wallet tokens from the hosted fields iframe.
issues.acceptance: Given a wallet token, when authorize is called, then a processor auth id is stored.

issues.description: Repeat capture with the same key must not double-capture.
issues.acceptance: Given a completed capture, when retried with the same key, then the original receipt is returned.

issues.description: Reject processor webhooks with invalid HMAC.
issues.acceptance: Given a bad signature, when the webhook arrives, then it is rejected with 401.

issues.description: Refund card first, then store credit.
issues.acceptance: Given a split tender, when a partial refund is issued, then card is refunded before credit.

issues.description: Persist the nightly settlement batch identifier.
issues.acceptance: Given a settlement file, when imported, then each capture stores the batch id.

issues.description: Soft-reserve units for fifteen minutes.
issues.acceptance: Given a checkout start, when reserve is called, then ATP drops for fifteen minutes.

issues.description: Return reserved units after timeout.
issues.acceptance: Given an expired reservation, when the sweeper runs, then ATP is restored.

issues.description: Apply inbound adjustment files from WMS.
issues.acceptance: Given an adjustment file, when imported, then on-hand matches the WMS delta.

issues.description: Emit an event when on-hand crosses the threshold.
issues.acceptance: Given on-hand dropping below five, when stock is updated, then a low-stock event is published.

issues.description: Keep a configurable safety quantity out of ATP.
issues.acceptance: Given safety stock of two, when on-hand is five, then ATP is three.

issues.description: Refresh the confirmation email layout.
issues.acceptance: Given a placed order, when email is rendered, then template v2 is used.

issues.description: Do not send marketing SMS overnight.
issues.acceptance: Given local time 23:30, when a marketing SMS is queued, then it is delayed until morning.

issues.description: One-click unsubscribe from the footer.
issues.acceptance: Given an unsubscribe click, when processed, then marketing email is off.

issues.description: Notify when BOPIS order is staged.
issues.acceptance: Given a staged pickup order, when the event arrives, then one push is sent.

issues.description: Replay failed email deliveries from the DLQ.
issues.acceptance: Given a failed send in the DLQ, when replay is invoked, then the email is retried once.

issues.description: Record support impersonation sessions.
issues.acceptance: Given an impersonation start, when audit is queried, then actor and target are stored.

issues.description: Release many holds from the ops console.
issues.acceptance: Given selected holds, when bulk release runs, then each hold is cleared.

issues.description: Gate the new pricing table behind a flag.
issues.acceptance: Given the flag off, when admin opens pricing, then the legacy table is shown.

issues.description: CSV of roles and permissions.
issues.acceptance: Given admin access, when export is clicked, then a CSV of the role matrix downloads.

issues.description: Allow a future publish timestamp.
issues.acceptance: Given a future timestamp, when saved, then publish waits until that time.
